examples: 'IrzyA jeyA tato rAgaH svayamASAH palAyate' (rAjata॰3.521). atra palAyatiH sakarmakaH, ASA iti ca karma. ASAH=diSaH.
'yo vAM prARo balaM yacca yA ca vo vEritA'surAH. tatkftvA hfdaye cEva palAyaDvamitaH puram' (mAtsya pu0 139.6). palAyaDvaM SIGraM DAvata.
'yatrA naraH samayante kftaDvajo yasminnAjA Bavati kiM cana priyam' (f॰7.83.2). samayante=saNgacCante (yuyutsayA).
'yajYasya vidvAn samaye na DIraH' (aTarva॰2.35.3). samayante saNgacCante yodDAro'treti samayaH saNgrAmaH.
'pOzRaM samudayantaM' (dugDam) (E0 brA0 4.26). samudayantaM samudayamAnaM santApavaSAdUrDvaM gacCat.
'yo BiyAto nilayate' (aTarva0 11.2.13). nilayate=nirayate. (nisaH prayogaScet). nizkrAmati, apayAtItyarTaH.
'asitaM te nilayanamAsTAnamasitaM tava' (tE0 brA0 2.4.4.1). nilayanaM rakzAsTAnam, SaraRam.
'prasUtyA agnirdeveByo nilAyata' (tE0 saM0 5.1.1.4). nilAyata niragacCat, tiro'Datta, tirohito'BUt.
'niDAyodaharaRaM trirvipalyayate' (Sa0 brA0 9.1.2.6). vipalyayate parikrAmati. upasargarePasya latvam. udaharaRaM GawaH, udakumBaH.
'yo adya stena Ayati saM sampizwo apAyati' (aTarva0 4.3.5). Ayati=Ayate=AyAti.
'so'gneH kfzRo rUpaM kftvodAyata' (tE0 saM0 5.2.6). udAyata nirAyata nirakrAmat.
'asurA vajramudyatya devAnaByAyanta' (tE0 saM0 6.2.7.4). aByAyanta aBimuKamAgaman, upAdravan.
